decisions.basis: Table15 explicitly says an entry number greater than /Size shall be ignored. Current T73 pins product retention for explicit current entry above Size; normal and older recovery controls are distinct. ADR2346 remains a choice; no retest of its corpus cost here.

decisions.decision: reaffirm explicit free/type0/unknown entry blocks older copy
decisions.basis: An explicit deletion is not an absent record. The classic incremental deletion test and corrected hybrid precedence witness cover the main rule. The short type-0 /W tolerance test does not establish valid producer conformance because it uses forbidden zero width for field 2; a valid explicit type-0 stream deletion control is drafted.

decisions.decision: reaffirm with actual stream collection order condition
decisions.basis: read_from_startxref collects newest section, same-section XRefStm, then Prev; first-wins stable dedup consequently implements precedence. Corrected T09 hybrid fixture has xref-stream self-entry.

decisions.decision: reaffirm #500 offset-default handling, with separate Type2-index policy
decisions.basis: #500 strikes the printed type1 offset default. entry_location refuses a missing offset field. Current test exercises absent offset; a valid incremental [0 4 2] control exercises missing type byte. The type2 zero-index fallback is an implementation choice backed by corpus interoperability and should not be described as an explicit Table18 default.

decisions.decision: reaffirm as damaged-section recovery policy only
decisions.basis: Entries declared but unread differ from explicit type0/free entries; recovery of a damaged section is not a valid-file conformance witness.

no_new_behavior_defect: All cell gaps found were either assertion granularity or invalid producer-form coverage, without a source-imposed reader refusal obligation. No new runtime failure is claimed.
